title: Antarctica gained record 695 billion tons of ice after decades of loss

Although this gain temporarily countered ongoing ice loss in other regions, it does not signify a change in Antarctica's long-term trend of declining ice mass.

title: No rooms, Rs 2.3 lakh a night: BRICS Summit sends Delhi hotel rates soaring
content: luxury hotels in the national capital are facing a sharp squeeze in room availability, with tariffs at some marquee properties climbing beyond Rs 2 lakh a night . the summit brings leaders of the expanded BRICS grouping to Delhi and marks two decades since the bloc’s founding .

title: Former Delhi chief secretary Rakesh Mehta dies by suicide at Noida residence
content: mehta, 74, a 1975-batch IAS officer, was found hanging from a ceiling fan at his Sector 82 residence on September 6 . he cited his "mental and health issues" as the reasons behind the extreme step . his body was cremated at the Lodhi Road crematorium .

title: 'Not intended to hurt anyone': Vijay clarifies assembly gesture after DMK protest
content: DMK accused him of attempting to body-shame former chief minister . he clarified that a gesture he made during his Assembly speech was inadvertent . this comes amid a major uproar in the assembly . the protesting legislators were later evicted from the house by marshals .

title: Ladakh LG taps 90 million litres of glacial water after village head's appeal
content: nearly 90 million litres of glacial water have started irrigating 12 villages in ladakh every day . the massive volume of glacier-melt, previously flowing untapped into the River Indus, is now being channelised into the Igoo-Phey Irrigation Canal . it was an appeal from a village chief that drove the LG to brainstorm on harnessing glaciers and snowmelt for productive use .

title: Holy Grail of AI or hype? What OpenAI's GPT‑6 Astra can do, and what it can't
content: astra is the "world's most intelligent and aligned model," openAI says . the company says Astra scored 99.9% on ARC-AGI-3, 98% on FrontierMath Tier 4 and 100% on ExploitBench .
